title: Over 23 Million Mangrove Trees Strengthen Coastal Sustainability in Jazan
description:
Jizan, July 26, 2026, SPA -- On the International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem, observed annually on July 26, the mangrove forests along the Jazan coastline continue to demonstrate the Kingdom's commitment to environmental conservation and the sustainable management of natural resources.
    The forests play a vital role in protecting coastal ecosystems and preserving biodiversity, underscoring the importance of mangroves in combating climate change and safeguarding marine habitats.
